title: The first Cotton Club show
summary: Leonard Harper's production opened with the Nicholas Brothers and others.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Do you remember your first -- the first show there?
No. The first show at the Cotton Club?

Oh, yeah. / It was heavy. The guy that staged the show was Leonard Harper Hopper. He had all them girls and different acts, of course, the first time we had a regular Broadway production up there and it was all right, you know, it wasn't nothing difficult about it. but we had the exact timing. We had the Nicholas Brothers the Berry Brothers, Peg Leg Bates Ethel Waters, they were the head -- a dance team and oh, 16 prettiest girls you ever saw, in the chorus, and they this show we rehearsed about -- we rehearsed the show -- we were playing there, you know, but we wasn't playing a show.

Yeah, we played the show, but I mean the new show, had about three weeks after we come in there, so we just played entertainment while they were rehearsing, but opening night, everybody in New York was there.
